distribution_model.detail: Owns or operates its theatres; hotels owned and managed for third-party owners, with on-site restaurants and bars.

market_position.detail: Movie theatres with premium amenities at mainstream prices; hotels from limited service to upper upscale.

notes: Market position blends mainstream theatres with upscale hotels; mass-market chosen as the single best fit.

product_category.detail: Movie theatre admissions and concessions; hotel and resort stays; in-theatre dining and hotel restaurants and bars.

purchase_frequency.detail: Moviegoing and hotel stays are discretionary leisure and travel purchases.

sub_sector.value: movie theatre circuit; hotel ownership and management
